args.summary:
Built a 2D spine-beam OpenSeesPy model of a 4-span cast-in-place prestressed concrete continuous box girder bridge (35+45+45+35 m, deck width 12.5 m), Highway Class I, one-way, 3 design lanes.

Modeling decisions:
- structure.idealization = spine_beam_2d; system = continuous_on_piers (pier columns modeled, MR-05/MR-06).
- Single cast_box girder: A = 6.712 m², I = 4.498 m⁴ (integrated section), Ec = 34500 MPa (C50), γ = 26.0 kN/m³, w = 174.512 kN/m, m = 17.79 t/m (girder self-weight only).
- Bearings (laminated elastomeric, 2 per line; Ge = 1.2 MPa manufacturer override):
  • Abutments 0 & 4: PTFE sliding 400×500, 5×11 mm — S=10.10, Kv=3.614e6 kN/m, Kh=0.
  • Piers 1 & 3: PTFE sliding 550×650, 6×11 mm — S=13.54, Kv=8.075e6 kN/m, Kh=0.
  • Pier 2: plain (fixed) 600×700, 7×11 mm — S=14.69, Kv=8.974e6 kN/m, Kh=13.09e3 kN/m (longitudinal spring).
- Pier columns (twin Ø1.8 m, C40 Ec=32500 MPa, base fixed): Pier1 L=26 m, Pier2 L=10 m, Pier3 L=29 m; A=5.089 m², I=1.031 m⁴ each.
- Live load: n_lanes=3, ξ=0.78, qk=10.5 kN/m, Pk=330/350/350/330 kN per span. Impact factor μ=0.157 from f1.

Analysis facts: first vertical bending frequency f1 = 2.66 Hz (next modes 3.61, 4.79 Hz). Self-weight support reactions ≈ 2266/7701/7988/7699/2267 kN. All L1/L2/L3 checks passed.
